entries.name: Standing Rope Crunch
entries.reason: Source-bound side-view draft with a spine that curls. Standing with the back to a high pulley and the rope ends held over the shoulders against the upper chest; the hips and legs do not move while the spine curls the trunk forward and down, a pause, and a slower return to standing tall. The hands travel with the upper chest, and the cable runs over the shoulder and only lengthens on the way down.
entries.summary: Standing with your back to a high pulley and the rope at the upper chest, curl the spine to crunch the torso down with the hips still, pause, then return slowly to standing tall.

frames.caption: Attach a rope to a high pulley, stand with your back to the machine and hold the rope ends over the shoulders against the upper chest.
Keeping the hips still, curl the spine to crunch the torso down as far as you can control.
Pause at the bottom. Rope stays at the upper chest.
